comment: Read against the maker's source at commit eb902fa on master. Five commits carry version 2.0.0 (467f615, c7d1e50, 0d5a3ae, 3310de2, eb902fa); the only code change among them is 0d5a3ae, which deleted the MFTexture and BitMap destructors to stop a crash on exit. The installed build settles it: neither BitMap::~BitMap nor the MFTexture shared-pointer deleter calls MFTexture::release, so the build shipped is 0d5a3ae or later, and the source at eb902fa is identical to it apart from the README. The whole plugin is eleven blank panels built from one template, src/Blanks.cpp, parameterised by width. Each loads a PNG rather than an SVG, so the panels do not render with rsvg-convert; the artwork is in res/8Bit_<n>HP.png, res/8Bit_Alt_<n>HP.png and res/8Bit_Ext_<n>HP.png. The three menu items are "Base", "Alternative" and "Extreme", built in BlankBaseWidget::appendContextMenu. The picture choice is a field on the widget, not on the module, and there is no dataToJson or dataFromJson anywhere in the plugin, so the choice cannot be saved with the patch. Under the house rule a cosmetic menu gets no line, but a blank panel is the exception STYLE names: being looked at is the module's whole function, so the three artwork items are written on each of them. No ports and no parameters anywhere in the plugin, so there are no tags, families or props to give.
